story.text: 김해공항 출구, 캐리어를 끌고 나오자마자 저 멀리서 누군가 손을 번쩍 들고 소리친다. "야! 여기다, 여기!"
story.reading: gim-hae-gong-hang chul-gu, kae-ri-eo-reul kkeul-go na-o-ja-ma-ja jeo meol-li-seo nu-gu-ga son-eul beon-jjeok deul-go so-ri-chin-da. ya! yeo-gi-da, yeo-gi!
story.en: Right as I walk out of Gimhae Airport's exit with my suitcase, someone far off throws a hand up and shouts, "Hey! Over here, over here!"

story.text: 몇 년 만인지 셀 수도 없는데, 선우는 하나도 안 변한 얼굴로 성큼성큼 걸어와 내 어깨를 툭 친다.
story.reading: myeot nyeon man-in-ji sel su-do eop-neun-de, seon-u-neun ha-na-do an byeon-han eol-gul-lo seong-keum-seong-keum geol-eo-wa nae eo-kkae-reul tuk chin-da.
story.en: It's been so many years I can't even count, but Sunwoo strides over with a face that hasn't changed a bit and gives my shoulder a light punch.

story.text: "니 얼굴 봐라, 하나도 안 변했네. 근데 캐리어는 와 이래 크노? 이민 오나?"
story.reading: ni eol-gul bwa-ra, ha-na-do an byeon-haet-ne. geun-de kae-ri-eo-neun wa i-rae keu-no? i-min o-na?
story.en: "Look at your face, hasn't changed one bit. But why's your suitcase this huge? You immigrating or something?"

story.text: "오랜만이다, 진짜." 나는 웃으며 그를 와락 껴안는다. 낯설지가 않다. 마치 어제도 만났던 사람처럼 편하다.
story.reading: o-raen-man-i-da, jin-jja. na-neun us-eu-myeo geu-reul wa-rak kkyeo-an-neun-da. nat-seol-ji-ga an-neun-da. ma-chi eo-je-do man-nat-deon sa-ram-cheo-reom pyeon-ha-da.
story.en: "It's really been forever." I laugh and pull him into a hug. It doesn't feel awkward at all. It feels as easy as if we'd met just yesterday.

story.text: "밥은 뭇나? 비행기서 준 거 말고, 사람 먹는 밥." 선우가 내 캐리어를 대신 끌며 앞장선다.
story.reading: bab-eun mun-na? bi-haeng-gi-seo jun geo mal-go, sa-ram meok-neun bab. seon-u-ga nae kae-ri-eo-reul dae-sin kkeul-myeo ap-jang-seon-da.
story.en: "You eat yet? Not the airline food, I mean real human food." Sunwoo grabs my suitcase for me and leads the way.

story.text: "오늘부터 열흘 내가 다 책임진다. 걱정 붙들어 매고 따라만 온나." 그의 목소리에는 예전 그대로의 여유와 반가움이 묻어 있다.
story.reading: o-neul-bu-teo yeol-heul nae-ga da chaek-im-jin-da. geok-jeong but-deul-eo mae-go tta-ra-man on-na. geu-ui mok-so-ri-e-neun ye-jeon geu-dae-ro-ui yeo-yu-wa ban-ga-um-i mu-deo it-da.
story.en: "Starting today, I've got the next ten days fully covered. Don't worry about a thing, just follow me." His voice carries the same easygoing warmth and genuine delight it always did.

story.text: 공항 밖으로 나서자 부산의 짭짤한 바닷바람이 훅 끼쳐온다. 오랜만의 재회인데도, 이상하게 하나도 서먹하지 않다.
story.reading: gong-hang bakk-eu-ro na-seo-ja bu-san-ui jjap-jjal-han ba-dat-ba-ram-i huk kki-cheo-on-da. o-raen-man-ui jae-hoe-in-de-do, i-sang-ha-ge ha-na-do seo-meok-ha-ji anh-da.
story.en: Stepping outside the airport, Busan's salty sea breeze hits me all at once. Even after such a long reunion, strangely, there's no awkwardness at all.

words.example_en: My friend was waiting at the exit.
He strode over briskly and greeted me.
Even after such a long time apart, it didn't feel unfamiliar.

words.meaning: to take the lead, to go first
words.example_en: He took the lead and showed the way.
I could sense the gladness on his face.

sentences.en: I met an old friend at the airport exit.
He strode over and greeted me warmly.
Even after so long, it didn't feel unfamiliar at all.
He took the lead and carried my bags for me.
His face was full of gladness.

turns.speaker: 선우
turns.text: 야! 여기다, 여기! 니 얼굴 봐라, 하나도 안 변했네.
turns.reading: ya! yeo-gi-da, yeo-gi! ni eol-gul bwa-ra, ha-na-do an byeon-haet-ne.
turns.en: Hey! Over here, over here! Look at your face, hasn't changed one bit.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.text: 너도 똑같다, 진짜. 몇 년 만이야, 이게.
turns.reading: neo-do ttok-gat-da, jin-jja. myeot nyeon man-i-ya, i-ge.
turns.en: You're exactly the same too, seriously. How many years has it even been.

turns.speaker: 선우
turns.text: 세보지도 마라, 서운해진다. 캐리어 이리 도. 내가 끌게.
turns.reading: se-bo-ji-do ma-ra, seo-un-hae-jin-da. kae-ri-eo i-ri do. nae-ga kkeul-ge.
turns.en: Don't even count, it'll make me sad. Give me the suitcase. I'll pull it.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.text: 괜찮아, 내가 끌 수 있어. 근데 진짜 고맙다.
turns.reading: gwaen-chan-a, nae-ga kkeul su iss-eo. geun-de jin-jja go-map-da.
turns.en: It's fine, I can pull it myself. But seriously, thanks.

dialogues.question: 선우가 공항에서 승객을 맞이하며 한 행동으로 알맞은 것은?
dialogues.question_en: What did Sunwoo do when he greeted the passenger at the airport?
dialogues.explanation: 선우는 반가운 마음에 승객의 캐리어를 자기가 끌겠다고 나섭니다.

turns.speaker: 선우
turns.text: 밥은 뭇나? 비행기서 준 거 말고, 사람 먹는 밥.
turns.reading: bab-eun mun-na? bi-haeng-gi-seo jun geo mal-go, sa-ram meok-neun bab.
turns.en: You eat yet? Not the airline food, I mean real human food.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.en: No, not yet. I just slept the whole flight.

turns.speaker: 선우
turns.text: 잘됐다. 오늘부터 열흘 내가 다 책임진다. 따라만 온나.
turns.reading: jal-dwaet-da. o-neul-bu-teo yeol-heul nae-ga da chaek-im-jin-da. tta-ra-man on-na.
turns.en: Good. Starting today, I've got the next ten days fully covered. Just follow me.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.text: 든든하네. 그럼 오늘은 뭐부터 먹으러 가?
turns.reading: deun-deun-ha-ne. geu-reom o-neul-eun mwo-bu-teo meok-eu-reo ga?
turns.en: That's reassuring. So what are we eating first today?

dialogues.question: 선우가 승객에게 제안한 것은 무엇인가요?
dialogues.question_en: What did Sunwoo propose to the passenger?
dialogues.correct_answer: 열흘 동안 여행을 자기가 책임지겠다는 것
options: 열흘 동안 여행을 자기가 책임지겠다는 것
dialogues.explanation: 선우는 오랜만에 만난 반가움에 앞으로 열흘 동안의 여행을 자기가 책임지겠다고 말합니다.
